parsed.rationale: All four types — AccentHueKey, AccentSaturationKey, AccentBrightnessKey, and LCDActiveBrightnessKey — are structurally identical SwiftUI EnvironmentKey boilerplate types living in the same file (AccentColorEnvironment.swift, package PlayerHeaderView) with shared_field_count of 1 and no differing slots. The only variation between them is their name and the associated default value/type, which are exactly the parameters a Swift macro can accept. A `@EnvironmentKey` attached macro would synthesize the conformance body, reducing four near-identical declarations to four one-liner macro invocations and making future additions trivial.

specifics.population_size_evidence: 4 type-alias-object members (AccentHueKey, AccentSaturationKey, AccentBrightnessKey, LCDActiveBrightnessKey) all in the same file AccentColorEnvironment.swift with shared_field_count: 1
specifics.synthesizes: A SwiftUI EnvironmentKey-conforming struct with a default `defaultValue` property, eliminating the need to hand-write each boilerplate key type. Each invocation would expand to a struct conforming to EnvironmentKey with a caller-supplied default value and type.
